messages:
maria: heads up: we need a safe way for internal SDKs and QA to hint or force routing (region/tier) without changing prod policies. thinking a single header like `x-rw-route: region=ap-northeast;tier=dedicated;mode=force|prefer|hint`. open to alternatives.

alex: single header + small parser in gateway sounds good. parsing should be deterministic and cheap. agree we must gate `mode=force` to internal tokens only (scoped).

chris: +1 on scope. propose token scope `route:force` and `route:simulate`. Also we should make clear precedence: 1) account hard mappings (contract) 2) console admin overrides 3) forced header (internal tokens) 4) prefer/hint header 5) smart routing defaults. anyone disagree?

siva: sounds reasonable. add tests to ensure quota/billing attribution is obvious. if header forces dedicated, we should check contract/commit before letting it consume dedicated capacity. block or alert otherwise.

karen: UX note: console logs and request detail view must show when a request used a header and whether it was forced or honored. otherwise ops will be confused when they see unexpected billing. show a small badge: "Route override (internal)" with link to audit.

maria: agreed. telemetry needs to expose the decision path. suggested tags: `route.decision`, `route.hint_source`, `route.final_region`, `route.final_tier`, `route.fallback_strategy`, `route.trace_id`. chris do you want to own metrics naming?

chris: I can own naming. final suggestion: `route.decision={contract|console_override|header_force|header_prefer|default}` and `route.hint_source={header|console}`. also log `route.varying_variant` when fallback occurs.

alex: implementation detail: gateway will parse `x-rw-route` and attach proto metadata: `route.hint.region`, `route.hint.tier`, `route.hint.mode`. policy engine runs purely on internal metadata. header parsing has zero external IO.

maria: example curl for QA (internal token required):

````
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL_TOKEN" \
     -H "x-rw-route: region=eu-west;tier=dedicated;mode=force" \
     -d '{"input":"test"}' \
     https://qa-api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
````

alex: ensure $INTERNAL_TOKEN has `scope:route:force`. also redact header values in public logs but keep an internal hashed key for grouping.

siva: tests: unit parse, policy precedence, e2e that verifies fallback to variant B in same region if primary variant is full. also a test for quota attribution when force would consume dedicated capacity but customer has no dedicated commit.

karen: console: add a "Simulate routing" modal that calls a new debug API (non-destructive) `POST /v1/_routing/simulate` returning resolved route and billing bucket. gated by `route:simulate` scope. show results in rollout UI.

alex: add SDK helper: Routing.from_env() that sets the header builder and only attaches `mode=force` if env `RW_ROUTE_DEBUG=1` and token has force scope. default SDK should never set force.

chris: fallback policy question: if the chosen tier/region lacks the primary variant, prefer to fallback to a compatible variant in the same region (latency) by default, but allow tenant-level policy `fallback.strategy=region_first|cost_first|cross_region` to override. default: `region_first` for latency SLAs.

maria: agree. and console should allow admins to set `fallback.strategy` per-account. show strategy in account config UI.

devex-bot: created CI job: `tests/routing/test_routing_header_policy.py::test_force_scope_blocked_for_noncommitted_account` (job #428). :white_check_mark:

maria: rollout plan: feature-flag `routing_header_v1`. deploy to internal -> staging -> canary -> prod. SDKs will ship helpers in next minor release but default behavior remains off. target internal rollout next week.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: branch `feat/routing-header` -> staging at 2026-04-06T09:00Z (deploy #1987).

chris: I'll add Grafana panels for `route.decision` counts and `route.fallback_strategy` split per model/region. need infra to expose counters to statsd.

siva: dependency noted: infra to expose `route.decision.*` metric before canary. I'll file infra ticket.

maria: owners: alex (gateway header parse + auth), chris (telemetry + metrics + grafana), siva (e2e tests + quota checks), karen (console UI + simulate modal + badges), devex (SDK helpers + docs). I'll create JIRA and link.

alex: small request: add endpoint `POST /v1/_routing/debug` that simulates resolution given payload+headers and returns the final route decisions and which policy fired. must be permissioned and rate-limited. very useful for QA.

karen: we'll add a "Try routing" button in the account page that calls that endpoint. show clear warning for force.

maria: perfect. any other blockers?

siva: none from infra besides the metrics exposure.

maria: great. i'll open follow-up JIRAs and update the RFC with final header syntax and telemetry tags. thanks all :rocket:
